device_entry.name: GPS定位接收器
tags: 移动机器人与自动驾驶实验
device_entry.description: 一种通过串口输出 NMEA 语句的 GPS 接收器，用于测量车辆、机器人或移动实验平台的地理位置。实验中可用于定位、轨迹记录，以及将经纬度转换为平面位置坐标以支持导航与路径分析。
device_entry.description_en: A GPS receiver that outputs NMEA sentences over a serial connection to measure the geographic position of a vehicle, robot, or other mobile experimental platform. In lab use, it supports positioning, trajectory logging, and conversion of latitude/longitude into planar position coordinates for navigation and path analysis.

schema.description: 处理一组输入的 NMEA 语句并转换为位置结果。
schema.description_en: Process a set of input NMEA sentences and convert them into a position result.

schema.description: 读取 GPS 接收器的当前数据并输出当前位置。
schema.description_en: Read the current data from the GPS receiver and output the current position.

schema.description: 返回后台持续更新的最近一次有效位置。
schema.description_en: Return the most recent valid position updated continuously in the background.

schema.description: 持续从 GPS 接收器读取 NMEA 数据并更新最新位置。
schema.description_en: Continuously read NMEA data from the GPS receiver and update the latest position.

schema.description: 停止定位读取并关闭设备连接。
schema.description_en: Stop position acquisition and close the device connection.
